    The mesh presentation of every fibre (Proposition 12.8, presentations) #

    deformation-refinements.tex: "Let ℬ be that mesh presentation with a path cutoff above the top degree of C. Its arrow map to ℳ is surjective by degree induction. Leading relations give surjections C ⊗ K → gr ℬ → gr ℳ = C ⊗ K whose composite fixes every arrow and object, hence is the identity. Both maps are isomorphisms."

    At each fibre t, the twisted lifted arrows realize kQ onto the morphisms of the lifted modules (realize_tw_surjective, by degree induction on leading terms).
